## Decisions and known gaps

### Indian Supreme Court Judgments (AWS Open Data Registry, maintained by Dattam Labs) — APPROVED

Explicit CC-BY-4.0 licence on the registry page; judgments are reproducible under s.52(1)(q)(iv); public bucket with documented bulk access.

Access constraints: Maintainers ask bulk users to prefer the tar archives over per-object requests, and to avoid high-concurrency scraping of the eCourts site. FormLaw streams the yearly tar archives sequentially.

* Third-party mirror of eCourts data (authoritative: false); users must verify against the official record.
* Only judgments published to the dataset are covered; orders and unreported judgments are not.

### Indian High Court Judgments (AWS Open Data Registry, maintained by Dattam Labs) — APPROVED

Same licence basis as the Supreme Court dataset. Adapter not yet implemented (partition layout must be mapped per court); not ingested.

Access constraints: Bulk access via tar archives only. Volume (~1.25 TiB) requires a server-side ingestion job, not a laptop.

* No adapter implemented yet: nothing ingested from this source.

### Constitution of India — Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice — UNDER_REVIEW

Terms require prior permission by e-mail; none on record. Import with legal-data/constitution/import_constitution.py once permission is granted.

Access constraints: Prior written permission required by the site's copyright policy.


### India Code (Legislative Department) — RESTRICTED

Usage rights for bulk ingestion unclear/restricted. BNS/BNSS/BSA texts therefore not ingested. The pre-existing IPC/CrPC excerpts in backend/app/agents/legal/corpus.py came with the original project and are flagged for the same review.

Access constraints: Automated access refused.


### Supreme Court of India website / e-SCR portal — UNDER_REVIEW

The same judgments are available under CC-BY-4.0 via aws_sc_judgments; scraping the official portal is unnecessary.

Access constraints: Dataset maintainers ask users not to scrape the portal at high concurrency.


### eCourts judgments portal (judgments.ecourts.gov.in) — RESTRICTED

Automated access restricted (CAPTCHA). Use aws_hc_judgments for High Court coverage.

Access constraints: CAPTCHA indicates automated access is not permitted.


### Indian Kanoon — REJECTED

No licence held. Could be added later via a paid API agreement.

Access constraints: Scraping not permitted.


### Community Constitution datasets on Hugging Face (e.g. TheVixhal/Indian_Constitution) — REJECTED

Not an authoritative text and the licence chain to the official source is unverifiable.


### Operator-supplied licensed files (provenance manifest) — APPROVED

Channel for licensed/permitted material (e.g. the Constitution once permission is granted).
